title: 第13章 过万里大竹林 修炼身法赶路第14章 没神晶怎么啦不丢人
content_zh:
郑风忍痛一路狂奔，在风神力的催动下，郑风身体本身就是一个移动阵盘，若是红衣队长还在世，会被郑风气得再死一次。郑风的速度之快，他真是拍马不及。有这么快的速度想走就走，还和自己死磕，不是找自己寻开心？
郑风到神界后发现自己很多不同之处，风雷剑一剑秒了武君初期的青衣队长，风雷拳一拳打出了近乎实物的拳头虚影。对风雷剑融合的明悟，现在的速度也是令自己都吃惊。
当然自己的另外一个灵魂体小郑风是这次战斗的受益者，收集了几位骑士的神魂和神力。还有有一个惊喜就是小郑风主持的阵法威力，比下界还给力。
进步是能切身体会的，但实力弱小也是能实实在在地感受到的，自己在神界这片天地还是不能飞行，面对半步武王也是蝼蚁，也就是说风雷宗外门弟子的入门级条件都还差得太远，只好退而求其次，进一个小小的剑门。
剑门的招收人员要是知道郑风此时的想法，说什么也不会让他进门。既然瞧不起我们剑门，还厚着脸赶来修行？
郑风狂奔的时候不由想起和鹏哥在一起的修炼，那时外出总是你追我赶，就是赶路也不忘修炼身法。
修行在日常，郑风决定琢磨一种适合自己的身法，现在自己就是一个移动的大阵，也可以简单理解成是一个移动阵盘。
身体内储存七种神力，还有众多神纹、阵点。
用于赶路最适合发动的无疑是风属性神力。
破开一路空气前行用锋锐坚实的金属性神力最好。
运用土属性神力防御风的阻力对自身的伤害。
要持久用木属性神力。
其他的火属性神力、水属性神力、雷属性神力暂时用不上。
在这个过程中“炼化诛神阵”一路吞噬四周神力可以减轻快速奔走的一部分损耗。
有了想法郑风就行动起来，郑风打算先刻意调动风属性神力和金属性神力两种，这样损耗小，行动敏捷，金的锋锐，风的增速，一路狂奔，快捷轻盈，郑风慢慢施展以前的各种步伐，在一路狂奔中琢磨各步法的优势。
不断的将优势融合，对，就是融合，看来无论生活还是修行，融合无处不在。看来自己一直走的融合这条武道之路，其实并不是那么高大上的存在，一直就存在自己的身边，就在自己的日常。
郑风想到了在下界时对天地大势的理解，其实势也是一直在每个人的身边，无处不在，只是你要主动去和他亲近，才能感应到。
郑风在一路修炼步伐的过程中，一心三用，感悟神力的运用，感悟步法的改进，感悟这片陌生天地的势。
神界众人不知道郑风这疯狂的想法，一个小小武君，也就是刚跨入武者的门槛，就想着神界高大上的天地大势，那是不是痴人说梦？
郑风的修行，到了神界的确算得上小白，在下界连进入武君也是稀里糊涂的，没有师承，因为他的师傅修为还没他高，他自己就是天元大陆武道修行的天花板。

郑风在不知不觉已经离康庄很远了，才发现进入一片满是竹林的区域，，这个竹林很有特点，根根直立，青翠欲滴，沿着一条宽阔的大道两边生长，两边望去，全是竹影，无论向左向右都一眼望不到头
这条大道也是一条唯一的大道，一头连接去康庄的地界，一头连着郑风未知的地界。
郑风无心看两旁的风景，虽然能感受到竹林充沛的神力，但为了尽快追上景儿一行人，郑风一路狂奔。
似乎是一种阵法运用的本能，小郑风一路收集了不少金属性神力、木属性神力、土属性神力、水属性神力，加上郑风身体的自行吸收，郑风感觉自己一点也没有耗费自身的神力。相应的上面这四种神力还得以壮大。
郑风一路狂奔了三个时辰才走出这条竹林，郑风现在的速度，三个时辰已是近万里，郑风感觉神界之大，如不身临其境，哪能明白，数百万里一个村庄，近万里一片竹林，下界几百里地的竹林被称为竹海，郑风自己觉得如今也是有见识的人了，相对村庄的大小，给他命名大竹林。如村旁的一处风景。
一出大竹林，郑风感觉视线特别开阔，一条大河出现在郑风面前，郑风所以称呼为大河，也是按照竹林路径距离评估的，其实在下界几万里的水面大都称作海，郑风不想被别人嘲笑，姑且称为大河。
这条河凡人和一般的武者都过不去，郑风是魂力强，不然一时半会怎没发现到。远远地隐约听到一群人闹哄哄的，看到一条船犹如一片树叶漂浮在水面上。
渐近看一艘船长约千米，高数十米，一行人围在购票处购买船票，不时传来争吵声。
“真丢人，没神晶就不要挡人家的路，站一边去。”一个少女的声音很是不屑。
“怎么啦，没神晶怎么啦？没神晶就很丢人吗？我可以上船打工找呀，多大的事！”一少年的声音传来，声音响亮，理直气壮。
“真丢人，没神晶还理直气壮，想上船打工？人家说了要人打工吗？”
郑风一听不由得加快了步伐，那个理直气壮的声音正是郑杰的，看来遇到麻烦了。
content_en:
Zheng Feng endured the pain and ran all the way. Under the urging of the wind god, Zheng Feng's body itself became a mobile array. If the red captain was still alive, Zheng Feng would be so angry that he died again. Zheng Feng's speed was so fast that he couldn't catch up with him. You can leave at such a fast speed when you want, and you are still fighting with yourself. Are you not looking for fun with yourself?
After Zheng Feng arrived in the God Realm, he found many differences in himself. The Fenglei Sword instantly killed the Qingyi captain in the early stage of Wujun, and the Fenglei Fist punched out a virtual shadow of a fist that was almost real. The clear understanding of the fusion of wind and thunder swords, and the current speed also surprised myself.
Of course, his other soul body, Xiao Zheng Feng, was the beneficiary of this battle and collected the souls and powers of several knights. Another surprise is that the power of the formation hosted by Xiao Zheng Feng is even more powerful than the lower realm.
Progress can be felt personally, but weakness can also be felt in real terms. I still can't fly in the God Realm, and I am still an ant facing the Half-Step Martial King. In other words, the entry-level conditions for the outer disciples of Fenglei Sect are still far away, so I have to settle for the second best and enter a small sword sect.
If the recruitment staff of Jianmen knew what Zheng Feng was thinking at this time, they would never let him in. Since you look down on our Jianmen, why do you come here to practice shamelessly?
While Zheng Feng was running wildly, he couldn't help but think of the practice with Brother Peng. At that time, you were always chasing after each other when going out, and he never forgot to practice his body skills even when he was on the road.
In daily practice, Zheng Feng decided to think about a body method that suits him. Now he is a moving formation, which can also be simply understood as a moving formation disk.
Seven kinds of divine power are stored in the body, as well as numerous divine patterns and formation points.
The most suitable thing to activate when traveling is undoubtedly the wind attribute power.
It is best to use sharp and solid metallic power to break through the air and move forward.
Use the divine power of earth to defend yourself against damage caused by wind resistance.
Use wood attribute power for a long time.
Other fire-attributed powers, water-attributed powers, and thunder-attributed powers are temporarily unavailable.
During this process, the "Refining God-killing Array" swallows up the surrounding divine power all the way, which can reduce some of the losses caused by running quickly.
Zheng Feng took action as soon as he had an idea. Zheng Feng planned to first deliberately mobilize the wind-attributed divine power and the metallic divine power. This way, he would lose less and move quickly. With the sharpness of gold and the speed of wind, he would run all the way, fast and light. Zheng Feng slowly used various steps from the past, pondering the advantages of each step while running wildly.
Constantly integrating advantages, yes, integration. It seems that integration is everywhere in life and practice. It seems that the martial arts path of fusion that I have been taking is actually not that high-end existence. It has always been around me, in my daily life.
Zheng Feng thought about his understanding of the general trend of the world when he was in the lower realm. In fact, the general trend is always around everyone, everywhere, but you have to take the initiative to get close to it to feel it.
In the process of practicing footwork, Zheng Feng focused on three things, comprehending the use of divine power, the improvement of footwork, and the momentum of this strange world.
Everyone in the God Realm didn't know Zheng Feng's crazy idea. A little martial lord, who had just stepped into the threshold of a warrior, thought about the great general trend of the heaven and earth in the God Realm. Is that a fool's errand?
Zheng Feng's practice is indeed considered a novice in the God Realm. In the lower realm, even entering the Martial Lord, he is confused and has no teacher, because his master's cultivation level is not as high as his, and he himself is the ceiling of Tianyuan Continent's martial arts practice.
Zheng Feng was already far away from Kangzhuang before he knew it, and then he realized that he had entered an area full of bamboo forests. This bamboo forest was very distinctive. The roots were upright and green. They grew along both sides of a wide avenue. Looking from both sides, they were full of bamboo shadows. No matter whether you looked left or right, you could not see the end.
This avenue is also the only avenue. One end is connected to the boundary of Kangzhuang, and the other end is connected to the unknown boundary of Zheng Feng.
Zheng Feng had no intention of looking at the scenery on both sides, although he could feel the abundant divine power of the bamboo forest, Zheng Feng ran all the way in order to catch up with Jing'er and his party as soon as possible.
It seems that it is an instinct to use the formation. Xiao Zheng Feng collected a lot of metallic divine power, wood attribute divine power, earth attribute divine power, and water attribute divine power along the way. Coupled with Zheng Feng's body's own absorption, Zheng Feng felt that he did not waste any of his own divine power. Correspondingly, the above four divine powers have been strengthened.
Zheng Feng ran all the way for three hours before getting out of this bamboo forest. Zheng Feng's current speed was nearly ten thousand miles in three hours. Zheng Feng felt that the divine world was so vast. If he had not been there, how could he understand that a village millions of miles away and a bamboo forest nearly ten thousand miles away, and the bamboo forest hundreds of miles below in the lower world was called the Bamboo Sea. Zheng Feng himself felt that he was now a knowledgeable person. Compared to the size of the village, he named it Big Bamboo Forest. Such as a scenery next to the village.
As soon as he came out of the big bamboo forest, Zheng Feng felt that his vision was particularly wide. A big river appeared in front of Zheng Feng. The reason why Zheng Feng called it a big river was based on the distance along the path of the bamboo forest. In fact, most of the water surface tens of thousands of miles away in the lower realm was called the sea. Zheng Feng didn't want to be laughed at by others, so he called it a big river.
This river is difficult for mortals and ordinary warriors to cross. Zheng Feng has a strong soul, otherwise how could he not have noticed it for a while. I vaguely heard a group of people making noise in the distance, and saw a boat floating on the water like a leaf.
As we approached, we saw a ship about a kilometer long and dozens of meters high. A group of people gathered around the ticket office to buy tickets, and quarrels could be heard from time to time.
"It's so shameful. If you don't have a divine crystal, don't block people's way. Just stand aside." A girl's voice was very disdainful.
"What's the matter? What's wrong without the Divine Crystal? Is it embarrassing to not have the Divine Crystal? I can go on the ship and work to find it, what a big deal!" came the voice of a young man, loud and confident.
"It's so shameful. You can still be confident without a divine crystal. You want to work on the ship? Did you say you want someone to work?"
Zheng Feng couldn't help but speed up his pace upon hearing this. The confident voice belonged to Zheng Jie. It seemed that he was in trouble.
